included.en: Protect adjacent surfaces, fill small holes, sand patches, spot-prime patches, apply two finish coats and clean up.
included.es: Proteger superficies adyacentes, resanar agujeros pequeños, lijar resanes, imprimar únicamente los resanes, aplicar dos manos de acabado y limpiar.

excluded.en: Ceilings, doors, trim, full-surface priming, major wall repairs and concealed damage.
excluded.es: Techos, puertas, molduras, imprimación de toda la superficie, reparaciones importantes y daños ocultos.

measurements.en: Seller supplied 12 × 10 ft and 8 ft height. Calculated gross walls: 352 sf. Full surface retained without opening deductions. Two coats do not change the wall area.
measurements.es: Medidas suministradas por el vendedor: 12 × 10 pies y 8 pies de alto. Superficie bruta calculada de paredes: 352 pies². Se conserva toda la superficie sin descontar aberturas. Las dos manos no cambian el área de las paredes.

preparation.en: Good wall condition and small holes reported. Standard cleaning, small-hole patching, sanding and spot priming assumed; no full priming.
preparation.es: Se reportan paredes en buen estado con agujeros pequeños. Se supone limpieza normal, resanes pequeños, lijado e imprimación localizada; no imprimación completa.

product.en: Editable allowance: standard interior acrylic wall paint, compatible patch compound and spot primer. Brand and exact product are not selected; no named catalog product is authorized.
product.es: Provisión editable: pintura acrílica interior estándar, compuesto para resanes e imprimador localizado compatibles. Marca y producto exacto sin seleccionar; no se autoriza un producto específico de catálogo.

finish.en: Editable assumption: one light color, eggshell finish, two coats.
finish.es: Supuesto editable: un color claro, acabado cáscara de huevo y dos manos.

assumptions.en: Provisional USD allowances: paint $35/gal; spot primer $20/qt; patching/sanding supplies $10/lot; masking/protection $15/lot; labor $45/hr. Labor is unconfigured, so $45/hr is an editable assumption, with 8 hr provisionally allowed. Paint coverage assumed 350 sf/gal per coat plus 10% waste: 2.21 gal, rounded to 3 gal. Allow 1 qt spot primer. All prices unverified.
assumptions.es: Provisiones en USD: pintura $35/gal; imprimador localizado $20/qt; materiales de resane/lijado $10/lote; enmascarado/protección $15/lote; mano de obra $45/hora. La tarifa laboral no está configurada: $45/hora es un supuesto editable, con una provisión de 8 horas. Rendimiento supuesto de pintura: 350 pies²/gal por mano más 10% de desperdicio: 2.21 gal, redondeados a 3 gal. Se prevé 1 qt de imprimador localizado. Todos los precios son provisionales, sin verificar.

provenance.en: Scope, dimensions and visible condition supplied by the seller; wall area calculated from those measurements, not field-verified. Products, coverage, waste, labor time and rates are disclosed estimating assumptions, not supplier quotes or internally approved prices.

preparation.en: Seller reports a dry, even base without visible damage. Remove carpet fixings and clean. Assume the base meets the selected flooring manufacturer's flatness and moisture requirements; verify after removal.

product.en: Editable allowance: residential click-lock vinyl planks with attached underlayment. Brand, exact model and box size remain unspecified; final selection must be compatible with the existing base without extra underlayment.
